correctness.rationale: Eliminate the image of z via Z=[X,Y]. The degree-two commutator entries are p=det(u,v) and s=det(v,w); the degree-three entry is central. Thus exactly su−pw=0 remains, independently of six higher coordinates. Independent u,w force v=0; for u=at,w=bt the left side is −2ab det(t,v)t. This gives the three coordinate four-spaces and the rank≤1 2×3 locus away from characteristic two, versus v=0 and det(u,w)=0 in characteristic two. In the former case each coordinate component has rank-two points and the rank-one locus has points with no zero column; in the latter case neither locus contains the other. Determinantal rank-one loci are geometrically irreducible with dense rational charts defined by a nonzero entry, with dimensions 4 for 2×3 and 3 for 2×2. Including free coordinates gives exactly the claimed dimensions and rationality. Independently stratifying by the outer columns gives (2q²−1)q² solutions with at least one outer column zero, (q²−1)(q−1) times q or q² with nonzero proportional outer columns (q away from characteristic two, q² in characteristic two), and (q²−1)(q²−q) with independent outer columns. Multiplying their sum by q⁶ gives both polynomials. The supplied code was inspected, not executed. Independent replay `python3 /workspace/audit_replay.py 1` checks actual nested brackets for all first-diagonal pairs at q=2,3,4,5, and all higher-coordinate lifts at q=2. It yields totals 2944,181521,5718016,34140625; this is a bounded check, not geometric or all-field certification.

evidence: At projected rank two the indexed proof explicitly gives the exceptional plane b=0; for all remaining planes the vanishing criterion is τ=0 in characteristic two and τ=0 plus αβ=0 otherwise. The same proof writes the triple brackets as functions of the first-diagonal minors α,β and the outer entries.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: At rank≤1 the displayed bracket equations vanish automatically. At rank two the exceptional plane gives v=0. In odd characteristic the other two allowed planes give u=0 and w=0. In characteristic two τ=0 is exactly det(u,w)=0 and already includes rank≤1 under closure. Taking the indicated coordinate spaces and standard irreducible rank-one determinantal loci therefore gives the full stated component list, dimensions and rational charts by their usual nonzero-entry parametrization. This uses the actual proof's vanishing criterion, not an inference of geometry from counts or matching parameters.
